record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764> on Neginoth<WH05058>, Maschil<WH04905><WTH8688>, <FI>A Psalm<Fi> of David<WH01732>, when the Ziphims<WH02130> came<WH0935><WTH8800> and said<WH0559><WTH8799> to Saul<WH07586>, Doth not David<WH01732> hide<WH05641><WTH8693> himself with us?<Fo><Fo> Save<WH03467><WTH8685> me, O God<WH0430>, by thy name<WH08034>, and judge<WH01777><WTH8799> me by thy strength<WH01369>. <RF>chief...: or, overseer<Rf> <RF>Maschil: or, of instruction<Rf>
Hear<WH08085><WTH8798> my prayer<WH08605>, O God<WH0430>; give ear<WH0238><WTH8685> to the words<WH0561> of my mouth<WH06310>.

For strangers<WH02114><WTH8801> are risen up<WH06965><WTH8804> against me, and oppressors<WH06184> seek<WH01245><WTH8765> after my soul<WH05315>: they have not set<WH07760><WTH8804> God<WH0430> before them. Selah<WH05542>.<CM>
Behold, God<WH0430> <FI>is<Fi> mine helper<WH05826><WTH8802>: the Lord<WH0136> <FI>is<Fi> with them that uphold<WH05564><WTH8802> my soul<WH05315>.

He shall reward<WH07725><WTH8686><WTH8675><WH07725><WTH8799> evil<WH07451> unto mine enemies<WH08324><WTH8802>: cut them off<WH06789><WTH8685> in thy truth<WH0571>. <RF>mine...: Heb. those that observe me<Rf>
I will freely<WH05071> sacrifice<WH02076><WTH8799> unto thee: I will praise<WH03034><WTH8686> thy name<WH08034>, O LORD<WH03068>; for <FI>it is<Fi> good<WH02896>.
For he hath delivered<WH05337><WTH8689> me out of all trouble<WH06869>: and mine eye<WH05869> hath seen<WH07200><WTH8804> <FI>his desire<Fi> upon mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>.<CM>
